edges.reason: msg.sender receives the minted total supply in the constructor.
msg.sender flows through ERC20 transfer/transferFrom into the overridden _transfer.
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline, making execution timestamp dependent.
_transfer invokes swapBack when the contract balance exceeds the swap threshold and swapping is enabled.
manualswap is publicly callable without onlyOwner and triggers swapTokensForEth on the contract balance.
manualsend performs an unchecked low-level value call to marketingWallet that can re-enter the token.
swapBack ends with an unchecked low-level value call to marketingWallet, an external re-entry point.
swapBack calls swapTokensForEth to convert accumulated tokens into ETH.
swapBack calls addLiquidity to pair tokens with the received ETH.
The router swap interacts with the token's own pair, allowing a malicious token/pair to call back into the contract.
addLiquidityETH performs an external payable router interaction that can re-enter during ETH handling.
_transfer accumulates the marketing share of fees into tokensForMarketing.
_transfer accumulates the liquidity share of fees into tokensForLiquidity.
swapBack resets tokensForMarketing after computing the ETH split.
swapBack resets tokensForLiquidity after computing the ETH split.
_transfer reads automatedMarketMakerPairs to classify transfers as buys or sells.
_transfer checks _isExcludedFromFees to decide whether fees apply.
_transfer checks _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount before enforcing limits.
_transfer only enforces anti-whale restrictions when limitsInEffect is true.
_transfer enforces maxTransactionAmount on buy and sell transfers.
_transfer enforces maxWallet on recipient balances.
_transfer reads and sets the swapping guard around swapBack.
_transfer compares the contract balance against swapTokensAtAmount to trigger swapBack.
swapBack routes leftover ETH to the marketingWallet state variable.
manualsend forwards the contract balance to the marketingWallet state variable.
onlyOwner enableTrading flips tradingActive, a privileged state transition.
onlyOwner enableTrading flips swapEnabled, a privileged state transition.
onlyOwner updateSwapEnabled toggles the swapEnabled state variable.
onlyOwner updateMarketingWallet rewrites the ETH recipient address.
onlyOwner excludeFromFees grants or revokes fee exemption.
onlyOwner setAutomatedMarketMakerPair updates the AMM pair mapping used for fee logic.
setAutomatedMarketMakerPair delegates the mapping write to the internal helper.
onlyOwner updateBuyFees rewrites buyTotalFees used in _transfer fee computation.
onlyOwner updateSellFees rewrites sellTotalFees used in _transfer fee computation.
onlyOwner updateMaxTxnAmount rewrites the transfer size limit.
onlyOwner updateMaxWalletAmount rewrites the wallet balance limit.
onlyOwner removeLimits irreversibly disables limitsInEffect.
onlyOwner updateSwapTokensAtAmount rewrites the swap trigger threshold.
onlyOwner excludeFromMaxTransaction toggles limit exemptions that bypass maxTransactionAmount and maxWallet.
The constructor registers the freshly created Uniswap pair in automatedMarketMakerPairs.
The constructor marks owner, contract and dead address as excluded from fees.
The constructor sets the marketingWallet state variable from the supplied wallet.
